help_invocation.relevant_excerpt:
--on-inconclusive MODE What a run whose verdict is inconclusive, and whose policy declares
                           no on-unknown handling, does to the exit status: pass (default)
                           reports it and exits 0 when no finding gates; unreliable exits 2.
                           A policy's on-unknown warn-unreliable or fail-closed outranks it

review_rule: Validate invocation and process status against the exact v0.14.4 captured argv/result (exit 0, completed) independently from schema-6 report completion. The report remains inconclusive when its typed completion is inconclusive; do not infer clean coverage from exit 0.
